'''Tom Ryan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Washington State Championship]] on 21 April 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents of the Black Sun]], according to Greg Otte's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2153">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-25-wa-states-from-the-lower-thirdd2153/ wa-states-from-the-lower-third], DeckTech (Greg "Rogue 9" Otte, 25 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-25-wa-states-from-the-lower-thirdd2153/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
